messages:
maria_cs: FYI customer (acct 8242) opened an escalation — they say outputs started confidently inventing partner names and dates after today's routing config change. They sent an example.
sam_engineer: Do we have model/variant and a request id or example text? :eyes:
maria_cs: They report it on rw-instruct-3b-v2.5 (canary). Example from their logs (request id req_0a1b2c3d):
```
User prompt: "Summarize the partnership timeline between Acme and NorthBridge."
Model response: "Acme announced a strategic deal with NorthBridge on March 3, 2021 led by founder Elena Whitman."
```
Customer says Elena Whitman is not associated with NorthBridge and dates are wrong — they saw many similar confident fabrications starting ~10:15 UTC.
nina_ml: Thanks — can you confirm sampling params and any system prompt? Also did we change caching/quantization or routing today?
maria_cs: They said temp=0.0, top_p=0.95, no custom system prompt. They noticed the spike right after we flipped routing policy from latency->cost-priority and a quant profile tweak (q4_0 -> q5_1) at ~10:14–10:16 UTC.
sam_engineer: I ran a quick local repro against rw-instruct-3b-v2.5 with the same prompt + params and can replicate the assertive fabrication. Repro steps attached:
```
# repro
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
 -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-3b-v2.5","prompt":"Summarize the partnership timeline between Acme and NorthBridge.","temperature":0.0,"top_p":0.95}'
# response (truncated)
"...Acme announced a strategic deal with NorthBridge on March 3, 2021 led by founder Elena Whitman..."
```
sam_engineer: also saw KL spike in next-token distrib around token 18 vs v2.4 baseline.
tara_oncall: We rolled a region-level routing change around 10:12-10:16 UTC (us-west-2). No weight changes to model files but we did enable aggressive KV eviction and adjusted prefix-caching TTL in that rollout.
alex_release: Confirmed. We swapped routing buckets and updated per-variant fallback maps. No new model weights pushed to production. The quant profile tweak was part of the canary mapping for cost buckets.
nina_ml: Hypothesis: increased traffic to the quantized variant + different prefix/KV behavior is changing context handling and causing assertive confabulations. Need a small eval run: compare v2.4 vs v2.5 on a 50-item factual QA set derived from the customer's prompts.
sam_engineer: I collected 3 reproducible examples and request ids: [req_0a1b2c3d, req_4d5e6f7g, req_8h9i0j1k]. Uploaded payloads and raw responses to /internal/triage/1918234567. Observed tokenization differences and different EOS behavior in v2.5 in some cases.
maria_cs: Customer is asking for immediate fallback to v2.4 for their traffic (they're on Dedicated). Can we pin their routing to v2.4 until we triage? They want a quick mitigation.
tara_oncall: I'll apply a per-account routing pin for acct 8242 to v2.4 and disable the aggressive KV eviction for their subset. ETA ~8 minutes. :clock1:
alex_release: If we see this affecting more customers we'll consider rolling back the routing change cluster-wide. For now we'll keep the pin and monitor.
nina_ml: I'll run the eval (50 qas) comparing v2.4 vs v2.5 over the customer's prompt distribution and post diffs in this thread in ~45 mins.
ops-bot: Created incident ticket INC-4582 and pinned logs under /internal/triage/1918234567.
maria_cs: Great — I'll update the customer that we've pinned them to v2.4 and are investigating. They've requested a postmortem if it's rollout-related. I'll keep them updated. :thumbsup:
